name: cadence
description: 讨论驱动的通用项目工作流插件 — 通过 记 / 整 / 查 三阶段协议自动落地决定、约束、待决问题和下一步,支持长 session handoff 与跨 session resume(Claude Code / OpenCode first-class,Codex / Kimi Code 兼容层)

interface.shortDescription: Domain-neutral project workflow for session decisions and TODOs.
interface.longDescription: Cadence captures decisions and TODOs from AI coding sessions into project archives, with built-in subagent dispatch for context-isolated retrieval and consolidation. It supports compacted contexts, session resets, and cross-session continuity. On Kimi Code it runs as a compat layer (same strategy as Codex): skill descriptions are discovered natively and the bootstrap body is loaded on demand by the LLM.
